title: Remote Conveyancing Paralegal
company: LEGAL TALENT PARTNERS LIMITED - Agency - Permanent
description:
Remote Conveyancing Paralegal

£30,000-40,000

Quality. Technology. Flexibility. A Better Way to Do Conveyancing.

We're partnering with a fast-growing, forward-thinking residential conveyancing firm that is using technology, smarter processes and a collaborative team structure to change the way property law is delivered.

The firm is built around a simple idea: conveyancing should be simpler, clearer and faster - for clients and the people delivering it.

If you're an experienced conveyancing paralegal looking for greater autonomy, better technology, a sustainable workload and the flexibility of a fully remote role, this could be an excellent next move.

Why This Role Stands Out

This is not a traditional conveyancing environment where paralegals are left to manage overwhelming caseloads with little support.

You'll work within small, collaborative teams, with regular check-ins, structured 1-to-1s, feedback and personalised training.

The firm takes a quality over quantity approach to workload, maintaining sustainable caseloads and giving teams capacity to deal with peaks without compromising client service.

You'll benefit from:
- Sustainable caseloads and a strong focus on work-life balance
- Small, collaborative teams
- Regular support, feedback and development
- Bespoke technology designed around legal teams
- A culture where asking for help is encouraged
- The opportunity to influence how technology and processes develop
- Fully remote working with genuine flexibility

The result? A more manageable workload, better support and the freedom to focus on delivering excellent conveyancing rather than simply processing as many files as possible.

The Role

As a Conveyancing Paralegal, you'll be an integral part of a residential conveyancing team, working alongside lawyers and other paralegals to deliver an excellent client service.

You'll work across freehold and leasehold sales, purchases and remortgages, taking ownership of your matters while working collaboratively with the wider team.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Progressing residential sales, purchases and remortgages
- Handling freehold sales with minimal supervision
- Managing most leasehold sale enquiries with minimal supervision
- Managing most freehold purchase enquiries with minimal supervision
- Liaising with clients, solicitors, estate agents and other third parties
- Proactively identifying issues and keeping transactions moving
- Reviewing and responding to enquiries
- Maintaining clear, jargon-free communication
- Using the firm's technology to manage your caseload efficiently
- Identifying and resolving potential issues before they become blockers
- Providing feedback to improve systems and processes

The firm's technology has been developed specifically around its conveyancing process, and legal professionals are encouraged to provide feedback on the tools they use every day.

About you

You'll ideally have:
- Strong experience in residential conveyancing
- Experience handling freehold sales with limited supervision
- Experience dealing with leasehold sale enquiries
- Experience dealing with freehold purchase enquiries
- Confidence communicating with clients and third parties
- A proactive approach to progressing transactions
- Strong organisation and attention to detail
- Excellent communication and problem-solving skills
- Confidence working independently in a remote environment
- An interest in using technology to improve legal work

You don't need to be qualified. This role is suited to an experienced paralegal with strong technical conveyancing skills who is ready to take greater ownership of their work.

Although fully remote, you won't be left alone with a laptop and a pile of files. Regular team check-ins, 1-to-1s and ongoing feedback are built into the firm's approach.

The Culture:

This is a firm deliberately doing things differently.

Rather than chasing maximum utilisation, it takes a sustainable approach to workload, helping teams maintain consistent service levels while giving people room to deal with the unexpected.

Its technology helps allocate work, streamline processes and keep teams informed, while its remote-working model is built around communication, supervision, feedback and development.

There's also a strong culture of transparency and continuous improvement. People are encouraged to share ideas, challenge processes and help shape the future of the business.

The Package
- £30,000-£40,000 depending on experience
- Fully remote - work from anywhere in the UK
- Flexible working hours
- 25 days' holiday + 3 days at Christmas + Bank Holidays
- Full home-working setup and equipment provided
- Comprehensive private healthcare
- Free access to Spill mental health and wellbeing support
- Company pension scheme
- Enhanced maternity, paternity and adoption leave
- Growth Shares, giving employees an opportunity to share in the long-term success of the business
- Fully paid-for annual company weekend
- Structured development and genuine progression opportunities

The firm's flexible approach is a key part of its culture, with many employees working flexible hours or part-time. The focus is on creating working patterns that work for both the individual and the wider team.

If you're an experienced conveyancing paralegal looking for a genuinely modern, supportive and flexible place to build your career, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Cash Allocation Administrator
description:
Cash Allocation Administrator

Are you a seeking a new opportunity?

We are seeking an enthusiastic and engaged individual to join the finance team to focus on cash allocation administration.

As part of this role you will be performing daily reconciliation and allocation of incoming cash using customer remittances for commercial accounts. Contacting customers via email and phone when remittances are missing or unclear, ensuring accurate allocation.

Join our client's team at The Point, Warwick Business Park and enjoy:

Fixed Term - 01/10/26 - 31/03/27 with potential for extension.

Competitive Pay: Earn £13.45 per hour, 37.5 hours per week, overtime rates of £20.18 per hour.
Shifts Monday to Friday - (minus 1 hour unpaid break)
Perks: Free on-site parking, provided PPE, comprehensive training.

Cash Allocation - Key Responsibilities
- Daily reconciliation and allocation of incoming cash using customer remittances for commercial accounts.
- Contacting customers via email and phone when remittances are missing or unclear, ensuring accurate allocation.
- Recording all activity in Salesforce, including attempts to obtain remittances and any issues affecting allocation.
- Reversing incorrect allocations and reallocating funds accurately when errors are identified.
- Identifying anomalies in remittances and proactively contacting customers to clarify or resolve discrepancies

Skills & Competencies
- Strong computer literacy and confidence using finance systems.
- Intermediate Excel skills (e.g., lookups, pivot tables, data manipulation).
- Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
- Clear and professional communication with internal teams and external customers.
- Good numerical ability and comfort working with financial data.
- Ability to maintain focus and accuracy when performing repetitive tasks.
- Experienced in using IT software such as SAP, OnBase, Microsoft outlook, Microsoft excel, salesforce.
- Successful candidates require a DBS check.

title: HR Administrator
description:
From Pipelines to Possibilities - Make Your Mark with Cadent

We are looking for organised, customer-focused, and detail-driven individuals to join Cadent as a People Services Administrator within the HR team.

As a People Services Administrator, you will provide key administrative support across a wide range of HR activities, acting as a first point of contact for employee queries and ensuring a high-quality, efficient service. You will play an important role in maintaining accurate HR records, supporting HR processes, and delivering excellent customer service to both internal and external stakeholders.

This is a fantastic opportunity to gain experience within HR while contributing to the smooth running of a vital support function in one of the UK's leading energy networks.

How Cadent Powers Britain

Cadent is shaping the future of UK energy. With a clear roadmap to support the UK government's net zero targets by 2050, Cadent is driving innovation and creating a cleaner, greener future for over 11 million customers. Join Cadent and be part of something big.

How You'll Make an Impact

In this role, you'll support the delivery of HR services by providing high-quality administrative and customer support. Your responsibilities will include:
- Acting as the first point of contact for HR queries via phone, email, and other channels
- Providing advice and guidance or signposting queries to the appropriate teams
- Supporting HR processes including onboarding, absence management, and employee records
- Maintaining accurate HR systems, databases, and employee files
- Preparing and issuing documentation such as contracts, letters, and forms
- Supporting probation reviews, exit processes, and general HR administration
- Managing shared inboxes and ensuring responses meet SLAs
- Building strong relationships with stakeholders across the business
- Ensuring all tasks are completed in line with Cadent policies and procedures
- Contributing to continuous improvement and service excellence

How We'll Know You're the Right Fit

We're looking for someone who is organised, proactive, and customer-focused. You'll ideally demonstrate:
- Working towards CIPD L3 or equivalent
- Experience in an administrative or customer service role
- Strong organisational skills and ability to prioritise workload
- Excellent communication skills (written and verbal)
- High attention to detail and accuracy
- Confidence working with data and systems
- Good knowledge of Microsoft Office
- A collaborative approach and ability to build strong working relationships
- An interest in HR (CIPD or similar is desirable but not essential)
- A proactive mindset and willingness to learn

How It All Comes Together
- Pay rate: £13.53 per hour (PAYE, paid weekly)
- Assignment duration: 26/02/2027
- Start date: ASAP
- Location: Pilot Way, Ansty Park, Coventry, West Midlands, CV7 9 JU
- Working pattern: Hybrid 2 days in the office, 3 days WFH, Monday to Friday, 37 hours per week (between 8am - 5pm)

How This Role Benefits You

Don't meet every single requirement listed? Cadent would still love to hear from you.

Cadent Gas values understanding, learning, and celebrating differences. They are an equitable and diverse employer, fostering an inclusive and accessible working environment for all.
- Recognised Disability Confident employer
- Inclusive employee communities
- Full training and on-the-job support
- Opportunity to gain HR experience within a leading UK organisation
- Free onsite parking
- Modern office facilities

How to Take the Next Step

If you're interested, please apply today with your updated CV.

A member of the Reed team will be in touch to guide you through the next steps, including a telephone interview, client interview, and pre-employment checks.

Be part of something big. Help keep Britain connected.

Accounts Assistant

Location: Rugby / DIRFT
Full-time 40 hours per week
Permanent

Macildowie are delighted to be partnering with a growing, privately owned property and development business to recruit an Accounts Assistant into their finance team.

This is a fantastic opportunity for someone who enjoys a varied, hands-on finance role and wants to join an energetic, fast-moving and down-to-earth business.

Working closely with the Financial Controllers and wider finance team, you'll take responsibility for a broad range of transactional accounting duties across several group companies. - Setting up and maintaining customer accounts and producing sales invoices
- Investigating and resolving customer queries
- Reviewing customer accounts and chasing outstanding debts
- Processing purchase invoices and credit card receipts
- Reconciling supplier statements

- Previous experience within an accounts or transactional finance role
- Strong attention to detail
- Good communication and relationship-building skills
- The ability to manage your own workload and work to deadlines
- Confidence balancing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
- A proactive, flexible and resilient approach
- Intermediate Excel skills

The business is also forward-thinking in its approach to technology, so an interest in using AI tools such as ChatGPT to improve or automate accounting processes would be particularly welcome.

Why Apply?

This is an opportunity to join a growing organisation where you'll be part of a small, dedicated team and have exposure to a genuinely varied range of finance activities.

You'll also need to be:
- Highly organised with excellent attention to detail

- Confident communicating with colleagues and external contacts
- Approachable, dependable and a strong team player

title: Private Client Paralegal
company: The Eventus Recruitment Group - Agency - Permanent
description:
Eventus Legal are seeking a Private Client Paralegal to join a specialist, Top Tier Legal 500-recognised private client law firm in Coventry, West Midlands. This is a full-time, permanent job position and offers the opportunity to develop within a growing specialist practice, supporting high and ultra-high-net-worth individuals, business owners and families whose affairs can include complex and international elements. The firm is employee trust owned and places strong emphasis on professional development, continuous learning and collaborative working.

Role Responsibilities

You will join an expanding specialist private client practice and provide paralegal support across high-quality private client work. The position offers exposure to a sophisticated client base and the opportunity to build your technical experience within a multi-disciplinary legal and tax environment. Key responsibilities will include:
- Supporting fee earners and specialists with a range of private client matters.
- Assisting with the preparation and progression of private client files and associated documentation.
- Communicating professionally with clients and third parties and helping to maintain a high standard of client service.
- Undertaking legal and administrative work to support the efficient progression of matters.
- Working collaboratively with colleagues across the firm's specialist legal and tax teams where matters require input from different disciplines.
- Developing your knowledge and experience through involvement in varied and technically interesting private client work.

Person Specification

This Private Client Paralegal opportunity would suit someone who is keen to develop within a specialist private client environment and enjoys working as part of a collaborative team. You should also be able to demonstrate the following:
- Existing experience or knowledge relevant to private client work.
- A genuine interest in developing a career within private client law.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills with a client-focused approach.
- Good organisation and attention to detail when managing documentation and competing priorities.
- The ability to work effectively as part of a team and contribute positively to a collaborative working environment.
- An aptitude for continuous learning, development and adapting to varied private client matters.

Benefits and Rewards

This is an opportunity to join a growing specialist practice with a strong reputation in the private client market and a clear commitment to developing its people. The successful Private Client Paralegal will also benefit from:
- Employee trust ownership, giving employees the opportunity to contribute to the firm's growth, strategic direction and future success.
- Investment in professional development and continuous learning.
- Opportunities for extended learning and development within a specialist private client practice.
- Opportunities to take part in volunteering and fundraising activities supported by the firm.
- Exposure to high-quality private client work for high and ultra-high-net-worth individuals, business owners and families, including matters with international aspects.
- A collaborative working environment with an open-door culture and strong emphasis on team working and participation.
- Office-based working within a specialist West Midlands private client practice.

About the Law Firm

This specialist, multi-disciplinary private client law firm brings together legal and tax expertise to advise individuals, trustees, business owners and families on complex wealth, estate and succession matters. The practice is Top Tier Legal 500-recognised for Personal Tax, Trusts and Probate in the West Midlands and is known for technically sophisticated private client work. Its employee trust ownership model supports an inclusive and collaborative culture, with employees encouraged to contribute to the continued development and success of the practice.

Next Steps

Apply now to be considered for this career-enhancing job opportunity. Alternatively, for a confidential discussion about this Private Client Paralegal job in Coventry, West Midlands, please send your CV to Gemma Clarke at the Eventus Recruitment Group for a confidential discussion. Due to the high volume of applications, if you have not heard from us within ten days, unfortunately you have not been shortlisted on this occasion.

If this job isn't quite right for you but you are looking for a new position, please contact me at the details above for a confidential discussion on your career.

The Eventus Recruitment Group are award-winning recruitment specialists operating in the Legal, Finance and Financial Planning sectors across the UK. Please note, the years' experience and/or salary are listed in our advertisements as a guide. We are happy to consider applications from all candidates who are able to demonstrate the skills necessary to fulfil the role. As an equal opportunities employer we welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds and circumstances. Our privacy policy can be found on the bottom of our website.

title: Part Time Website Content Coordinator
description:
Website Content Coordinator

Location: Coventry CV4 and home working

Salary: £17,000 to £18,900 pro rata actual (Up to £33,000 FTE)

Hours: Part-time, 20 hours per week flexible

Contract: 9-month fixed-term contract

Benefits: Excellent holiday entitlement, contributory pension scheme, onsite parking and employee assistance programme

We are working on behalf of esteemed organisation, who are recruiting a creative and user-focused Website Content Coordinator to support one of the organisation's most significant digital transformation projects. This is an exciting opportunity to play a leading role in reviewing, rewriting and creating engaging website content that ensures their audience can find information quickly, access services easily and connect with everything the organisation has to offer.

As Website Content Coordinator, you will work in a small Communications & Marketing team, reporting into the Communications & Marketing Coordinator and working closely with the Communications & Marketing Director. You will also collaborate with colleagues across the organisation and the website project team to ensure content is clear, accessible, accurate and aligned with user needs, research insights and Warwick SU's brand.

The role is part-time at 20 hours per week. There are no fixed working days: the employer is happy to be flexible depending on the successful candidate and their needs, including considering shorter working days across the week. The business has a hybrid working policy with flexibility to work from home dependent on operational requirements.

This is a 9-month fixed-term contract based on the budget currently available for this project role.

Role and responsibilities:
- As a Website Content Coordinator, you will lead the audit, review and redevelopment of website content across the organisation, ensuring content is relevant, engaging and meets user needs.
- Write, edit and proofread high-quality website copy that reflects the organisations tone of voice, brand values and accessibility standards.
- Work closely with colleagues across the organisation to gather information, understand services and translate complex information into clear, student-friendly content.
- Apply user research, content strategy and digital best practice to improve website usability, navigation and overall user experience.
- Collaborate with the website project team to ensure content aligns with the new website structure, design, user journeys and project milestones.
- Support content migration, quality assurance and population of the new website using the content management system.
- Contribute to content governance processes, editorial standards and sustainable workflows that support long-term website maintenance.
- Build positive relationships across departments and help ensure website content remains accurate, relevant and up to date.

Skills and experience required:
- Demonstrable experience writing, editing and proofreading content for websites or other digital channels.
- Experience managing complex content projects involving multiple stakeholders.
- Experience gathering information from subject matter experts and translating it into engaging content for target audiences.
- Experience reviewing and improving content for usability, readability and accessibility.
- Exceptional written communication and copywriting skills, with excellent attention to detail.
- Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects and competing deadlines.
- Strong relationship-building and stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to work collaboratively across an organisation.
- Understanding of digital content best practice, including accessibility and user-centred content design.
- Proactive, self-motivated and able to work independently, with a curious and analytical approach to understanding user needs.
- Experience of website redevelopment or digital transformation projects and familiarity with content management systems would be advantageous.

Benefits:
- Pro rota holiday entitlement based on 22 days annual leave including Bank Holidays and additional closure days
- Enhanced pension scheme
- Wellbeing programme
- Onsite parking
- BUPA cash plan
- Employee assistance programme

Interviews are scheduled for week commencing 21st and 28th September 2026.

If you are looking for a creative digital content role where you can make an impact, then please apply for this Website Content Coordinator opportunity.

title: Customer Supply Coordinator
description:
Hybrid Full Time Permanent

About the Role

An exciting opportunity has arisen for a Customer Supply Coordinator to join a busy supply chain operation based in Warwick, UK. The role will take responsibility for order planning, key account fulfilment and delivery coordination, helping to maximise product availability while managing logistics efficiently and cost-effectively.

Working closely with customers, supply sources, logistics providers, sales and finance teams, you will coordinate end-to-end supply requirements and support a high standard of customer service. This position would suit an analytical and commercially minded professional with experience in supply chain planning, order management, logistics or key account support, together with strong Excel skills.

Duties & Responsibilities
- Take ownership of order planning and order management for key customer accounts, using established processes alongside account-specific requirements.
- Coordinate cross-functional activity between customers, supply sources, logistics providers, sales and finance teams to maintain effective order fulfilment.
- Work closely with customers and internal teams to maximise product availability in line with demand, agreed targets and commercial campaigns.
- Use SAP and Microsoft Excel to combine datasets, analyse information and produce accurate internal and external reports.
- Proactively plan and communicate delivery requirements with third-party logistics providers (3 PLs), identifying opportunities to improve availability and logistics efficiency.
- Investigate delivery discrepancies and coordinate appropriate solutions while balancing customer service requirements with operational costs.
- Build productive relationships with internal and external partners while proactively managing customer enquiries through to resolution.
- Support key account performance through strong commercial awareness, effective communication and an understanding of customer requirements.

Education & Skills Required
- Previous relevant experience in supply chain, planning, order management, logistics, key account support or a related business environment, or a relevant educational qualification.
- Supply chain, key account support or business-related education is advantageous, although no specific degree is required.
- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint; experience with Power BI and SAP would be beneficial, but is not essential.
- Strong analytical, problem-solving and critical-thinking skills, with excellent accuracy and attention to detail.
- Confident communication, negotiation and influencing skills, with the ability to build effective relationships with internal teams, customers and external partners.
- Strong organisational and commercial skills, with the ability to prioritise multiple responsibilities, adapt to changing requirements and travel when business needs require it.

Hours: 9:00am - 5:30pm
Location: Leamington Spa.
Working Pattern: Hybrid - 3 days in the office and 2 days working from home, with flexibility.

If you have the planning, analytical and customer-focused skills to succeed as a Customer Supply Coordinator, apply today. This is an excellent opportunity to develop your supply chain career within a collaborative international working environment.

title: HR Assistant

title: Admin Assistant
description: Join Our OpCourage Veterans Mental Health Team! Exciting opportunity for an enthusiastic Administrator to join our Veterans Mental Health Team, supporting veterans and their families across the West Midlands. As one of the first points of contact for many of the veterans accessing our service, you will play a really important role in making sure they receive a warm, professional and supportive experience from the very first contact. Working alongside our dedicated team of clinicians, your role will include a range of general administrative duties, including answering calls and emails, managing appointments, maintaining accurate records, supporting clinical teams, data entry and helping the service run smoothly day to day. But this role is about much more than administration -- you'll be part of a team that genuinely cares about the work we do and the veterans we support. If you're organised, approachable, compassionate and enjoy working as part of a team, we'd love to hear from you. Come and join us and be part of something that makes a real difference to the lives of veterans and their families. To provide efficient secretarial and administrative support to the clinical team, adhering to procedures and processes within service timescales, whilst operating within a busy and demanding environment. Operate and maintain a robust, accurate and secure filing system that is easily accessible by all staff. Maintain spread sheets and databases including the production of regular information reports Linking in with NHS colleagues within our partnership including BSMHFT and LPFT and our Military Charity partners including Walking with the Wounded and The Ripple Pond. Be responsible for organising and servicing meetings / events as required, including room bookings, taking accurate notes, transcription and circulation as appropriate Procurement - order stationery, clinical supplies and equipment stock Use own initiative to meet tight deadlines Provide flexible administrative and clerical cover as required. This will involve working occasionally in both pathways, to provide cross cover arrangements.

title: Receptionist
description: PLEASE NOTE THE HOURS REQUIRED FOR THIS ROLE ARE 13:30 - 18:30 Monday to Friday. We are seeking a professional and friendly Receptionist to join our team. The ideal candidate will be the first point of contact for our patients and visitors, providing exceptional customer service while managing various tasks. This role is essential in ensuring the smooth operation of our GP Practice. Maintaining and monitoring the Practice appointments system Processing personal requests for appointments, visits and telephone consultations and ensuring callers are directed to the appropriate healthcare professional. Processing and distributing incoming and outgoing mail. Explaining practice arrangements and formal requirements to new patients and those seeking temporary cover and ensure procedures are completed. Receiving and making telephone calls as required. Divert calls and take messages, ensuring accuracy of detail and prompt appropriate delivery. Processing prescriptions in accordance with practice guidelines Computer data entry/data allocation and collation; processing and recording information in accordance with Practice procedures. Initiating contact with and responding to requests from patients, other team members and associated healthcare agencies and providers Advise patients of relevant charges for private (non-General Medical Services), accept payment and issue receipts. Clearing and re-stocking consulting rooms as required. Providing administrative support to the Practice as required, including filing, photocopying and scanning. Keeping the reception area, noticeboards, and leaflet dispensers tidy and free from obstructions and clutter Providing cover for reception / administrative colleagues during absence due to holiday or sick leave. Maintaining and monitoring the practice appointment system Process personal, telephone and e-requests for appointments. Answer incoming phone calls, transferring calls or dealing with the callers request appropriately. Signpost patients to the correct service. Input data into the patients healthcare records, as necessary. Direct requests for information i.e. SAR, insurance / solicitors letters, and DVLA forms to the administrative team Support in the management of repeat prescriptions, ensuring they are processed accurately and efficiently. Process repeat prescription requests received by any means of communication in accordance with practice protocol. Ensure all prescription requests are processed and are ready for collection within the required and expected timeframe. Generate requests for medication on behalf of the patient for non-repeat items. Discuss with patients their requirements, encouraging patients to order only what they require. Act upon compliance issues, liaising with the appropriate clinician. Ensure medication reviews are arranged by maintaining an accurate recall system. Effectively liaise with external services, i.e., district nurses, to ensure medicaments are arranged for housebound patients. Initiate contact with and respond to, requests from patients, team members, and external agencies. Manage all queries as necessary in an efficient manner. Act as a chaperone as required. Undertake all mandatory training and induction programmes deemed suitable by the Practice Manager / Partners. Be an integral part of the general practice team. Support all clinical staff with general tasks as requested. Maintain a clean, tidy, effective working area at all times. Providing administrative support to the Practice as required, including filing, photocopying, scanning, culling of notes. Support reception staff, providing cover during staff absences. Scanning of patient related documentation and attaching scanned documents to patients healthcare records Complete opening and closing procedures in accordance with the duty rota. Support administrative staff, providing cover during staff absences. Participate in local initiatives to enhance service delivery and patient care.
